author: Al12dean
quote:
Verdict: not worth it right now. I played the whole thing and requested a refund.
Performance and polish
Console is locked at 30fps with no 60fps mode, and driving feels rough. I've seen map falls and glitches. As a developer, the icons and UI look unfinished to me. It feels rushed, and I believe it was released in this state because delaying again would have hurt with investors.
Development
I don't believe real production started right after Red Dead 2. My read is that Rockstar spent years milking GTA Online and only got serious after the 2022 leak, then got pushed even harder by the Cyberleek leaks. The 2022 leak looked like a framework, not a game.
Systems that fight the sandbox
Hunger is not optional. and overeating is penalized too. You can't steal cars in your own neighborhood or equip weapons at home. For a game called Grand Theft Auto, that's a big limit. Autosave wasn't active right away, which is the bare minimum.
Monetization and release
Some in-world shops and salons are locked behind the Ultimate Edition. At launch, GTA+ was reportedly sold with a promise that it wouldn't lock gameplay behind a paywall. It's digital-only, and boxed copies ship with download codes, with reports of missing or already-used ones.
Content and tone
The sex-for-hire mechanic is gone for the first time since 2001. Strip clubs remain, but without that edge and with NSFW limits, I think the game lost what made GTA fun. I can't even cheat, yet the relationship system makes it feel like a dating sim. I support women's rights and normal feminism, but I don't like having it forced on me, and I feel the tone has been shifted toward a left-leaning audience compared with older games. I think it's designed for roleplayers, not people who want chaos, and that crowd will be the one that sticks around once online servers launch. The ending disappointed me.
Critics vs. players
Critics gave it a 99, but the Metacritic user score is around 5. I scrolled through comment sections on the biggest streams and saw almost nothing positive, and the few positive comments I saw got buried. I don't trust early-access coverage. I suspect gifts, access, and fear of losing publisher relationships shaped how many creators and outlets covered it, and I suspect Rockstar pressures people who get early access.
Refunds
I've seen claims it's the most refunded game ever. I can't point to public data, but I refunded mine, and I'm seeing others do the same.
Prediction
Once the hype fades, I expect the player base to drop sharply within one to three months. GTA V stays the better sandbox, and GTA 6 becomes a niche roleplay game.
Score: _/10
